newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian food company share offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian food company share offer oversubscribed.

text.p: The Egyptian food company Hostess/Universal Foods said on Saturday its offer of about 1.07 million shares in the company at 60 pounds ($17.68) a share was oversubscribed more than two times over.
The company received applications for shares worth over 200 million pounds within four days of the offer opening, it said.
The company was allocating international institutions 55 percent of the shares on offer, equivalent to 25 percent of the shares the institutions applied for.
Individuals would receive the remaining 45 percent of the shares on offer -- 48 percent of what they wanted, it added.

The company, which makes cakes under licence from Interstate Bakeries Corp of the United States, said the aim of the share sale was to finance an expansion plan which includes setting up factories in other Arab countries and adding 30 new product lines at a rate of six a year.
